title: Deploy synthetic tenant replays to validate per-model topology and heatmap fidelity
creator: Marcus Lee
description: Create and run a synthetic-tenant replay harness that emits realistic, multi-region telemetry (ingest events, rate-limit retries, delayed shards, and backfill batches) to validate that Console per-model breakdowns, heatmaps, and top-model charts remain stable and explainable after staggered ingestion and retroactive backfills. The goal is to catch stealth imbalances introduced by staggered rate-limit enforcement and shard replay ordering before they affect customer-facing dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic replay tool can produce configurable scenarios: rate-limit bursts, delayed shard delivery, DST boundary shift, and multi-region clock skew
Automated runs detect deviations >2% between live-simulated aggregate and canonical ledger for per-model token counts and surface alerts to the console-test dashboard
A reconciliation playbook (runbook) is created that lists remediation steps and a conservative hotfix plan for production discrepancies
At least three independent synthetic scenarios have passed in CI with no unexplained chart divergences for 48h simulated window
PRD + design sign-off and one peer engineering review completed for any code that touches aggregation logic
steps: Design replay schema: event types, timestamps, shard ids, tenant ids, model ids, token counts, rate_limit_marker metadata
Implement a replay generator library (python) that emits protobuf events to the staging ingest topic with tunable delay distributions
Create canary consumer in staging that applies the same aggregation pipeline as production and exports parity metrics to a test dashboard
Instrument parity probes that compare canary aggregates with a reference in-memory ledger and compute per-model drift metrics
Run a matrix of scenarios (burst sizes, backfill batch sizes, regional delay patterns) and capture heatmap diffs
Iterate on aggregation watermarking and late-window heuristics until drift is within tolerance or documented as acceptable
Document the runbook and link to dashboards and PRs; schedule a demo with PM/Design/Observability
